articles.headline: Anthropic expands access to frontier AI models for cybersecurity testing
articles.summary: Anthropic is broadening vetted access to its advanced models for security researchers, signaling greater enterprise use in vulnerability discovery and defensive testing. That can help companies improve security workflows, but it also reflects rising concern that powerful AI can accelerate both defense and attack capabilities.

articles.headline: Meta, Walmart, Stripe and Sierra publish open standard for AI agents used by businesses
articles.summary: A new open standard aims to define how AI agents interact with businesses, which could shape procurement, integration, and governance choices for enterprises. If adopted broadly, it may reduce integration friction and help firms manage risks when deploying customer-facing or back-office agents.

articles.headline: TSMC and other Taiwan players boost AI spending in the U.S. and Southeast Asia
articles.summary: Supply-chain rebalancing around AI demand points to more investment outside Taiwan, with implications for capacity, procurement, and geographic risk management. Enterprises buying AI hardware or dependent on chips should expect continuing changes in lead times, pricing, and regional availability.
